resources.string: Local controls only. No cloud policy can enable or lock a charging restriction.
Allow this phone to charge Qi accessories. NFC stays off while active; the wireless driver stops automatically when no receiver is found.
Use Xiaomi’s local cycle-count and battery-health strategies. Turning this off stops the service and removes its voltage limit.
Prefer maximum supported wired charging speed. Thermal and hardware safety limits still apply.
Controls compatible Xiaomi docks over the wireless protocol. Thermal and hardware safety limits always remain active.
Power the phone while reducing battery charging. Automatically turns off when unplugged.
Connect a wired charger and charge the battery to at least 40% first.
Turn off NFC while charging wirelessly
Optionally avoids interference between NFC and the wireless charging coils. NFC is restored only if charging turned it off.
